description: AI Agents (inside one system): Use when the person asks for this in a system whose AI agent may change records: New values for an item next to the six record types, such as a product price, a coupon, a custom record or a pipeline's stages; only what is given changes. Give one item per record, at most 25. Nothing is written yet: the answer shows, per record, what it holds now and would hold after, plus a proposal id. Show it to the person, say so first when something would be sent to the people in their system, ask whether to go ahead, and only then call apply_proposal; when needsApproval is true, share the approve link instead. Not for reading (use search_records or get_record).

items.description: One object per record, at most 25.

item_id.description: The id of the item, as list_items gives it.

item_kind.description: Which kind of item to change.

parent.description: The item it sits in, where the kind needs one: the object of a custom record, the product of a price, the project of a task, the task of a comment.

values.description: The values to change, as get_item shows them.

system.description: Which AI agent: the system's id from get_ai_agents_info, or the name of the system or its connection. Ask the person which AI agent they mean unless they named it in this conversation; never pick one yourself.
